integrity: The finite statements have algebraic all-order proofs; exact enumeration checks reproducibility but is not offered as an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two independent uniform spanning trees of a simple complete bipartite graph only. This is an exact second-moment and fixed-order variance extremum, not a full law or an assertion about weighted graphs. Priority remains qualified because a later version of a directly related 2025 paper was not fully inspectable.
title: Exact variance and a nine-to-ten-vertex extremal transition for bipartite spanning-tree overlap
